title: 3 Ways to Say "Sorry" Like a Native Speaker #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Sorry" in English. Don't just say "Sorry". Here are three phrases native speakers use:
• My mistake. (when you got it wrong)
• I owe you an apology. (when it's serious)
• My apologies. (formal, at work)

Want 15 ways to say sorry? Watch the full lesson on this channel: Other Ways to Say Sorry in English: 15 Better Phrases (With Examples)
